T0533.title: Artifact Repository
T0533.definition: A repository that stores build outputs, packages, container images, and release artifacts.
T0533.description: Artifact repositories store packages, images, build outputs, and release versions that production systems may eventually run. Weak access control, missing signature checks, or poor retention policies can allow malicious uploads, image replacement, or unsafe rollbacks. Controls focus on provenance verification, tiered permissions, immutable releases, and download auditing.
T0533.usageExample: Assess Artifact Repository related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
